name: mech-67-orb-pouch-room
source: mech-67-orb-pouch Test Level: pouch level (counter counts up). Orb-door shortcut D (cost 1) in the divider before the scale S (cost 2); spending on the shortcut first arrives at the scale one orb short and the player must go back (long way round the bottom) for orbs passed on the way. Saving for the scale opens the gate G (opens on pouch spent, not collected) to the warp X; unspent pouch orbs are the score at the warp.

*.label: pouch orb (collects up into the pouch)
